name: ReCell: exact fine collar + computed enriched Galerkin core + learned Loewner-bounded constitutive corrections, condensed exactly in FP64
one_paragraph: ReCell keeps the one rung of the measured amplification ladder where the accuracy requirement is ordinary: instead of emitting S or its factor (which needs 1e-4..1e-5 relative coherence between a near field and a far field that cancel at ratio 1e3-1e4 [STRUCTURE OF S][ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS]), the network predicts multiplicative SPD corrections (21 log-Cholesky numbers per coarse cell, ~23k-50k numbers per cell) to a reduced cell model that is otherwise computed exactly from the analytic geometry: the full fine CutFEM Q2+GP stiffness is assembled (0.44 s, cheap; only its 218k-dof factorisation is expensive), projected onto a geometry-computed Galerkin subspace made of an exact fine collar, a Q2 coarse core embedded in the fine space, and per-cell enrichment modes obtained from local patch eigen-solves, and the interface Schur complement Ŝ is the exact FP64 condensation of that ~60k-dof system. Because sums, congruences and Schur complements preserve Loewner order, a 3% gate is a 3% requirement on local tensors, not 1e-4 on entries; SPD, the exact 6-dimensional rigid null space, cube-group equivariance, gauge-freedom (only the span of the enrichment modes enters) and a teacher-free lower bound Ŝ ≥ (1-δ)S hold by construction, and the discontinuous combinatorics of the label map (active set, GP faces) are computed rather than learned. The collar-plus-Q1-core experiment already reached eps_op 0.15 with 23,016 numbers and failed ±10% only through a proven kinematic floor (mu_max ≥ 1.111) [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED e]; ReCell removes that floor by enriching the space (sized by an oracle n-width computation before any training), makes the learned part structurally bounded, trains it with a whitened two-sided extreme-mode loss through the exact condensation with adjoint gradients, and targets 2-5 s per cell on one FP64 GPU against 31.85 s on 64 cores, with the honest statement that a reduced interior solve remains at inference and the cost claim must be measured in stage 0.
representation: Ŝ(g) = exact Schur complement onto the (exactly computed) trace of K_red(g,θ) = Vᵀ K_fine V with learned SPD corrections Θ(θ) applied blockwise. Components. (1) K_fine(g): full CutFEM Q2 + ghost-penalty stiffness (231k dofs at 0328) assembled exactly from the 65³ analytic fields; each cut-cell matrix is linear in 125 monomial moments of the material region, GP face matrices are constants selected by the exact face set. Assembly is cheap (body 0.44 s measured); the teacher's cost is the factorisation, not the assembly [GOAL]. The exact active set, GP graph and trace set are computed, so the label map's discontinuities [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY] are reproduced, not interpolated. (2) V(g): a geometry-computed subspace of the fine space, V = [I_trace ⊕ I_collar ⊕ Φ_core ⊕ Φ_enr]: the fine collar (all fine dofs within k layers of the trace, k=1 ≈ 40k dofs, k=2 as a lever); a coarse core on the 16³ grid with Q2 (or Q1+EAS) kinematics embedded in the fine Q2 space by interpolation; per coarse cell m ∈ [4,16] enrichment modes computed at inference from K_fine restricted to an oversampled patch (cell + one ring): the lowest generalised eigenmodes of the local energy (GenEO/GMsFEM type, material-adaptive) and/or shell-kinematic modes u = u_mid + θ×(x−x_mid) on the local mid-surface φ=0, multiplied by a partition of unity. Only span(V) enters the projection, so there is no gauge (unlike SVD factors [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]). With Θ = I the model is Galerkin: Ŝ_nom ≥ S exactly (measured mu_min = 1.000 for the collar model) and its excess η = mu_max − 1 is the Kolmogorov n-width of A-harmonic extensions in V, computable with the fine factor by the existing Loewner-bound tool. (3) Θ(θ): per coarse cell c and per enrichment block, a multiplicative SPD correction in log-Cholesky form around the projected nominal tensor, D_c = L_c^nom exp(Σ_c) (L_c^nom)ᵀ with eig(exp Σ_c) clamped to [1−δ_s, 1+δ_h] (δ_s ≤ 0.5 rules out mechanisms; δ_h ≤ 0.1); ~21 numbers per cell, 23k-50k per cell total. Structural guarantees: symmetric, PSD, exact 6-dim rigid null space (element strain operators annihilate rigid motions for any tensor, so the 38.8% diagonal-only attractor cannot exist [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]), exact O_h equivariance with an equivariant encoder, Loewner-monotone in θ, teacher-free sandwich (1−δ_s)S ≤ Ŝ ≤ (1+δ_h)(1+η)S, and the ×1 amplification: if the network is within Loewner δ_net of the per-seat oracle tensors D*_c, then eps_op(Ŝ) ≤ δ_net + eps_fit + δ_net·eps_fit. Deployed object is literally Ŝ = Bᵀ Â B on the exact trace set; the reduced cell model (~60k dofs) is an equally valid, assemblable carrier because exact condensation composes to 1e-12 [ASSEMBLY]. Cost of the exact part: reduced interior 50-70k dofs, FP64 sparse Cholesky ~1e10-1e11 flops (<1 s GPU); explicit Ŝ needs the 12.8k-RHS Schur export (~1e12 flops, 1-3 s data-centre GPU, ~10 s consumer); implicit action = two triangular solves (ms). FP64 is mandatory for every additive formation (cond(A)·u32 = 4e-3).
teacher_and_data: Teacher: keep the frozen CutFEM Q2, n=32, GP γ=η=1e-4 teacher as reference [GOAL] but run, before any label generation, the γ-sweep on seat 0328 (γ = 1e-3 and 1e-5, two teacher runs, minutes) and read the whitened spectrum between γ-variants. If > ~20 modes move by > 10%, the deciding soft directions are stabilisation-defined and the labels are regenerated with a continuous stabilisation: keep the GP form but make each face/aggregation weight a C¹ function w(v) of the neighbouring cut-cell volume fraction (smooth AgFEM-type extension in the sense of 'Linking ghost penalty and aggregated unfitted methods' and 'On the design of locking free ghost penalty stabilization'), which removes the hard-classifier flips (1e-12 threshold → mu_max 1.25 [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]) while keeping every direction FP64-measurable [STRUCTURE OF S]; acceptance of the new teacher = Tet10 compliance validation unchanged (0.05-0.10%) and whitened central differences at h = 1e-4 vs 1e-3 agreeing to O(h²) on the thickness path. Cost ≈ 1024 × 32 s on 64 cores ≈ 9 h. If the sweep shows the deciding modes are physical (thin-sheet bending: cond ≈ (L/2h_node)·12(L/t)² ≈ 7e4 is what a two-element-thick shell gives), keep the labels and the unfloored gate. Labels: (i) factor all 1024 condensed packets on GPU (dense Cholesky at d ≈ 13k ≈ 7e11 flops, seconds; largest q ≈ 48k ≈ 1 min), turning 33 whitened labels into 1024 (registered train/dev/holdout splits preserved; holdout never screened); (ii) per-seat oracle tensor fields D*_c: fit the corrections against R* through the exact condensation with a nearest-to-nominal Thompson-metric regulariser so the field is unique and continuous in geometry; (iii) local labels without the teacher: per coarse cell the exact oversampled local condensation (patch of ~3-8k fine dofs, milliseconds) as a homogenised nominal tensor, ~1e3 per cell × 1024 cells × 48 symmetries ≈ 5e7 local samples; (iv) per-node compliance scales from packets (already R² 0.98 locally [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]) as auxiliary targets. CUT cells: none of the 33 factors is CUT [GOAL]; generate ~100 CUT seats with the teacher (~1 h on 64 cores) before any CUT claim; the per-cell architecture treats a cut plane as another exact active-set change. Coverage: register the local-descriptor coverage (thickness t = 2τ/|∇φ|, curvature, orientation, volume fraction, GP-face count) of the seats against the TO design range and generate seats where it is missing; cross-seat operator distances (eps_op 536-3847 [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]) are irrelevant to a local-field learner but the local descriptor space must be covered. Symmetry: the 48 cube operations are exact and used as equivariance, not augmentation.
architecture: Input: the 65³×11 analytic fields plus exact discrete channels computed from the level set (active-cell mask, per-cell volume fraction, GP-face count, node support measure, cut-plane distance, coordinates/face id) — full 3D, never six face images (V1's receptive radius 0.23 could not see the sheet [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]). Encoder: an O_h-equivariant 3D group-convolutional U-Net (CubeNet-style group convolutions extended to the 48-element group including reflections) on the 32³ cell grid, ≤ 5M parameters, whose coarsest level gives a global receptive field (bending stiffness depends on thickness everywhere) while all outputs are local; bf16/fp32 trunk. Heads (weight-shared, equivariant, all local): H1 core-tensor head → per coarse cell 21 log-Cholesky numbers of Σ_c, transforming as a rank-2 tensor in Voigt form under O_h, clamped to the Loewner range; H2 enrichment-block head → per cell an m×m SPD correction for the enrichment block (same form); H3 auxiliary compliance-scale head (per node, used for loss whitening and as a regulariser, not in the operator); optional H4 (later) collar-patch head predicting local condensed collar blocks from local labels to replace the fine collar's cut-cell assembly. Deterministic exact decoder (FP64, differentiable by adjoint): GPU moment quadrature → K_fine; local patch eigen-solves → Φ_enr (batched LOBPCG, ~1,100 patches); projection Vᵀ K_fine V (sparse products); blockwise correction by exp(Σ); nested-dissection sparse Cholesky of the reduced interior; Schur export (explicit) or two triangular solves per action (implicit); Ŝ = Bᵀ Â B. Equivariance of the computed parts is automatic on the symmetric grid because only spans enter. Everything the network emits is O(1) in a multiplicative gauge around a computed nominal, so head outputs need 1e-2 accuracy, not 1e-4, and fp32 suffices for them; every additive/condensation step is FP64. Inference-time symmetrisation (average the 48 frame predictions of Σ) is available as a cheap variance reducer.
loss_and_training: Stage A (local supervised pretraining, no teacher in the loop): regress Σ_c to the per-seat oracle fields D*_c (and to oversampled-local-condensation nominals on unlabelled geometries) with the Thompson/Loewner distance on the 6×6 SPD cone, d_T(D, D*) = max|log eig(D*^{-1/2} D D*^{-1/2})|, which is exactly the quantity that enters the ×1 amplification; auxiliary compliance-scale loss. Stage B (end-to-end through the exact condensation, whitened, two-sided, worst-direction): for training seats with R*, M = R*^{-T} Â R*^{-1} is applied implicitly (one reduced solve + two dense triangular solves per matvec, 3.3e8 flops each); warm-started block Lanczos/LOBPCG with 32 vectors per end (stiff end on M, soft end on the pencil (A, Â)), 2-5 iterations per step, full restart every ~100 steps, teacher soft eigenvectors as fixed probes (lower bound at zero cost). Gradients by Hellmann-Feynman with frozen Ritz vectors (the detached Rayleigh surrogate of 'Factored Sparse Approximate Inverse Preconditioning via Spectral Optimization'): d mu_k/dθ = w_kᵀ (dÂ/dθ) w_k, w_k = R*^{-1} v_k, and for a condensed model wᵀ Ŝ w = min energy, so the gradient with respect to each cell's tensor is the strain energy of the worst modes' reduced harmonic extension in that cell — adjoint sensitivity, k sparse solves per step. Loss = Σ_ends softmax-hinge over |log mu_k| beyond ε (curriculum ε: 0.3 → 0.1 → 0.03) + whitened bulk term D/d (diagnostic and conditioning only; never a gate [METRIC]) + a Schatten-2k Hutchinson term tr((M−I)^{2k})^{1/2k} (k=16, 16 probes) as a smooth, d-almost-independent upper bound on eps_op. Two-sidedness is enforced from the first step (a one-sided term moved mu_max 15→5 while mu_min 0.13→0.05 [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]). Optimiser: Gauss-Newton/K-FAC-type second-order steps on the head parameters (the whitened objective in the multiplicative gauge is well conditioned; the project's Newton+column-scale fit converged where raw Adam NaN'd [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]); FP64 loss arithmetic. Stage C (task-level fine-tuning, registered scope): 2-cell/2×2×2/4×4×4 assemblies with heterogeneous cells, self-equilibrated and non-equilibrated loads, adjoint compliance sensitivities along thickness paths matched to the teacher's stable task-level derivative (0.023% [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]) — Sobolev training on stable derivatives only, in the spirit of 'Multiscale topology optimization using neural network surrogate models'. Acceptance during training: only frozen checkpoints, full FP64 whitened spectrum, dev seats from the training partition; s* rescaling only as a diagnostic.
acceptance_and_deployment: Contract (answers open decision 1): module-level Loewner sandwich, eps_op ≤ 0.10 work / 0.03 target, evaluated by the full FP64 whitened spectrum on frozen checkpoints for held-out labelled seats — it composes exactly to any lattice, load and design ((1−ε)K ≤ K̂ ≤ (1+ε)K, compliance within ~±ε, energy-norm displacement error ε/(1−ε)) and it is sharp, whereas the measured 0.31% compliance error at eps_op 0.152 is construction-specific [ASSEMBLY]. Two additions: (a) a teacher-free structural guarantee for every geometry, Ŝ ≥ (1−δ_s)S (no spurious mechanisms, assembled SPD-ness and conditioning bounded), and the empirical distribution of η (the Galerkin excess) over held-out seats; (b) a registered task-level suite that must also pass: compliance error ≤ 0.3% (below the Tet10 reference's own refinement change 0.11-0.27% [ASSEMBLY]), displacement energy-norm error ≤ ε, and adjoint design-sensitivity error ≤ 5% with no sign errors on registered load families (sensitivities are first order in the operator error and untested; per 'Stress-constrained topology optimization of lattice-like structures using component-wise reduced order models' they behave like stress, ~10× worse than compliance). A stiffness-floored (shifted) metric is adopted only if the γ-sweep shows the deciding modes are stabilisation-defined, and then registered explicitly. Deployment (open decisions 2 and 3): mode A (proxy), with a reduced interior solve at inference accepted because the analysis shows it is the price of near/far coherence; the deliverable is the reduced cell model (~60k dofs, assemblable) with on-demand exact condensation, explicit (dense or H-compressed at ~15% of dense [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a] for storage) or implicit (ms per action). Honest cost: per new cell, GPU moment quadrature + fine assembly ≈ 0.5 s, batched local eigen-solves ≈ 0.5-1 s, network ≈ 0.1 s, reduced FP64 factorisation ≈ 0.5 s, explicit 12.8k-RHS Schur export 1-3 s on a data-centre FP64 GPU (≈10 s on a consumer part) — ≈ 2-5 s per cell against 31.85 s × 64 cores, roughly 10× wall-clock and ~100× hardware-cost; today's 30 s collar pipeline is CPU tooling, and the estimate is a stage-0 measurement, not a claim. For lattices of N ≈ 10³ cells, assemble the reduced cells (≈ 6e7 dofs) and solve with a multilevel/BDDC-preconditioned CG whose per-cell block is the implicit Ŝ; dense per-cell S (1.3 GB each) was never a lattice option. Error control in TO: the cheaply assembled K_fine gives a per-cell a-posteriori residual of the reduced harmonic extension (fine equilibrium residual, energy-bounded with a few reduced-preconditioned PCG steps), used as a trust-region indicator (per 'A trust region framework for managing the use of approximation models in optimization' and 'A non-conforming dual approach for adaptive Trust-Region Reduced Basis approximation'), with teacher checkpoints (32 s per cell) at trust-region centres and at the final design; sensitivities are the consistent adjoint of the surrogate with the enrichment basis frozen per design step ('Approximate reanalysis in topology optimization'). Mode B is kept only as a fallback: the reduced model is a natural preconditioner for the fine interior, but the fine action costs a 218k-dof PCG per application, which makes it uneconomic for explicit Ŝ.
staged_plan: Stage 0 (week 1, no training, existing tools + teacher rebuild): 0a γ-sweep on 0328 (γ = 1e-3, 1e-5; 2 teacher runs) → outcome: number of whitened modes moving > 10% between γ-variants; > 20 triggers label regeneration/floored metric. 0b classify the deciding modes of the H-matrix 0.03, Newton 0.047 and collar 0.15 verdicts as bending/membrane/fragment (thickness-exponent test: uniform τ scaling should give mu ≈ (1+δ) for membrane and (1+δ)³ for bending; energy partition with the level-set normal) → outcome: whether the 3-of-12,792 modes are physical. 0c interior-vs-boundary switch test (activate an interior sliver vs a collar sliver, eps_op change) → falsifies 'the exact collar captures the discontinuity'. 0d Loewner floor η of candidate spaces on 0328 + 3 seats: collar depth {1,2} × core {Q1, Q2, Q2+EAS} × enrichment m ∈ {0,4,8,16} (GenEO patch modes, shell-kinematic modes) → outcome: a configuration with η ≤ 0.05 at ≤ 80k reduced dofs; also the cheapest no-learning space that passes ±10%. 0e timing of GPU moment quadrature, batched patch eigen-solves and the FP64 reduced condensation → outcome: ≤ 5 s per cell end-to-end. 0f factor all 1024 packets on GPU. Cost: ~1 week, 1 GPU + a few 64-core teacher hours.

Stage 1 (weeks 2-3, oracle fits, still no network): fit D*_c on 8-16 seats through the exact condensation with nearest-to-nominal regularisation → outcome: eps_fit ≤ 0.05 on each seat with the stage-0d space (falsifies the claim that enrichment lifts the 0.111 floor). Noise sensitivity: perturb D*_c in log-Cholesky at 1e-2, 3e-2, 1e-1 relative → outcome: eps_op ≈ perturbation size (×1 ladder); if 3% tensor noise costs > 0.06 eps_op the parameterisation amplifies and must be re-whitened. Identifiability within a seat: ridge/kNN from local descriptors to D*_c with 20% of cells held out, substitute, recondense → outcome: eps_op within 2× of eps_fit; failure means the tensors are not a local function of geometry and the learned-enrichment variant (network predicts the mode span, gauge-free subspace-alignment loss) is tried once. Cost: 2 weeks, 1-2 GPUs.

Stage 2 (weeks 3-5, one-seat memorisation, first neural eps_op ever): full pipeline (equivariant encoder + heads + exact condensation + whitened two-sided extreme-mode loss with adjoint gradients) trained on 0328 and its 48 images only → outcome: train eps_op ≤ 0.10 (work gate) on 0328; also measures which residual model the network follows (tensor-coherent vs independent) and the first real precision budget. Cost: days on 1 GPU.

Stage 3 (weeks 5-8, generalisation): leave-one-seat-out over 33 seats, then train/dev on the 1024 factored packets with stage-A pretraining on local labels → outcome: held-out median eps_op ≤ 0.10, max ≤ 0.15, training at the oracle floor; report the held-out residual noise model and η distribution. Cost: 3 weeks, 2-4 GPUs.

Stage 4 (weeks 8-10, assembly and task level): heterogeneous 2-cell, 2×2×2 and 4×4×4 assemblies from held-out cells; compliance, energy-norm displacement, adjoint sensitivities along thickness paths vs the teacher; calibrate the a-posteriori residual indicator against measured eps_op → outcome: compliance ≤ 0.3%, sensitivities ≤ 5% without sign errors, indicator monotone in eps_op. Cost: 2 weeks with the existing harness extended.

Stage 5 (weeks 10-14, CUT cells, teacher continuity, mini-TO): ~100 CUT seats generated and evaluated; label regeneration executed if stage 0a triggered it (9 h) and the LOSO result re-run; mini-TO on an 8×8×8 lattice with trust-region control and teacher checkpoints → outcome: same primary load paths and objective within 1% of the teacher-driven TO, thin-feature differences registered (per 'One-shot procedures for efficient minimum compliance topology optimization'). Cost: 4 weeks.

Stage 6 (weeks 14-20, target gate and deployment): tighten the curriculum to ε = 0.03; H4 learned collar patches to remove cut-cell collar assembly if stage 0e shows it dominates; lattice deliverable (reduced cells + BDDC-type solver with implicit Ŝ blocks) benchmarked like-for-like including the assembled solve on both sides → outcome: held-out eps_op ≤ 0.03 on ≥ 90% of seats, ≤ 0.10 on all, and ≥ 10× wall-clock advantage per cell on one GPU vs 64 cores.
kill_criteria: Stage 0d: no geometry-computed Galerkin space of ≤ 100k reduced dofs reaches a Loewner floor η ≤ 0.05 on the four labelled seats (with Q2/EAS core, collar depth 2 and 16 enrichment modes) → the coarse-model prior cannot pass ±3% by construction at any useful reduction; stop the path (a richer space converges to the teacher's own cost).

Stage 0e: after GPU implementation, the reduced pipeline (quadrature + patch solves + FP64 condensation) exceeds 10 s per cell on a data-centre GPU, or the explicit Schur export cannot be avoided by the consumer and exceeds 15 s → cost advantage < 3×; either accept implicit-only deployment with the user's sign-off or stop.

Stage 0a + user decision: > 100 modes move by > 10% between γ = 1e-3 and 1e-5 teachers AND the user refuses both label regeneration and a registered floored metric → the unfloored ±3% gate demands reproduction of an arbitrary stabilisation parameter; no smooth surrogate can meet it near switching events; stop.

Stage 1: 3% Loewner noise on the oracle tensors D*_c costs eps_op > 0.06 (parameterisation amplifies), or the within-seat identifiability test scatters held-out cells to eps_op > 2× eps_fit after the nearest-to-nominal refit and after one learned-enrichment attempt → the learned quantity is not a local function of geometry; stop the learning component (the no-learning reduced model from 0d remains as the deliverable if it passes ±10%).

Stage 2: one-seat memorisation cannot reach train eps_op ≤ 0.10 on 0328 within 5 GPU-days while the oracle fit on the same space sits ≤ 0.05 → optimisation/loss failure of the pipeline; if a second attempt with the Schatten-2k bound and second-order steps also fails, stop.

Stage 3: with 1024 factored labels and stage-A pretraining, held-out eps_op median > 0.30 while training seats sit at the floor → the geometry → field map is not learnable at the required 1-3% tensor precision from this data; abandon mode A as a proxy and retain only the trust-region/error-controlled use with teacher checkpoints.

Stage 4: at module eps_op ≤ 0.10, adjoint design sensitivities on registered loads err by > 20% or change sign → the module contract does not imply TO fitness for this surrogate; either move to a task-level contract with trust region (user decision) or stop.

Stage 5: mini-TO with trust-region control reaches a design whose teacher-evaluated compliance is > 3% worse than the teacher-driven TO optimum on two of three benchmark problems → the surrogate steers the optimiser; stop mode-A TO use.
what_it_discards_from_current_assets: Discarded as targets or backends: the TᵀDT lifting backend and its descent line (superelement/neural_schur/backend.py, e1c/e1d/e1e/e1f scripts; closed-form oracle 63-204× above the line, eps_op 15.2 at 7.4M params [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED d]); the banded-L + low-rank-M representation and the V0/V1 6-face CNN (v0_superelement.py, v1_superelement.py, run_v1*.sh, class_chain*.sh; one-sided, lambda_min(H0) 0.02-0.13, mu_max 670 [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED c][LEARNING ATTEMPTS]); the closed-form block-diagonal D oracle and fixed-L reachability criterion (reachability.py; specific to dead representations); the free dense factor as a learning target (step1_*.py stays only as a diagnostic of loss ceilings); the H-matrix as a learning target (hmat*.py is kept as the storage/compression format for explicit Ŝ and as the evaluation reference, never as the thing the network predicts, because its SVD factors are gauge-non-unique and its 1.2e7 numbers need 1e-4 each [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]); D/d as a headline number (diagnostic only); probe/action-MSE supervision; all no-GP assets; the hard-classifier internal-extension GP prototype (replaced by a C¹-blended weight if regeneration is triggered); the 6-face image input format and augmentation-only symmetry handling. Kept and re-used: the full-spectrum FP64 evaluator (spectrum_eval.py, shifted-whitening option), the assembly harnesses (assemble.py, assemble_tight.py) extended to heterogeneous cells and adjoint sensitivities, storage_floor.py, the teacher rebuild chain (gp_build.py at the frozen commit) for γ-sweeps, CUT seats and regeneration, the Loewner-bound tool from the B2 collar round as the n-width oracle, the B2 collar pipeline itself as the seed of the reduced model (its local assembly 17.7 s + pre-elimination 7.7 s are replaced by GPU quadrature and a reduced nested-dissection factorisation), the per-entry noise tool (perentry.py/coher.py) repurposed to tensor-level Loewner noise, the compliance-scale regressor from PRECONDITIONER_SOURCE as an auxiliary head/whitening, the 1024 packets + 33 factors (factoring the remaining 991), and the registered train/dev/holdout splits. Datasets regenerated only if stage 0a triggers it; ~100 CUT seats are new.
key_risks: Kinematic floor does not fall enough: enriching the core (Q2, EAS, GenEO/shell modes) may leave η > 0.05 at affordable dof counts because the softest modes vary along thin curves and oscillate across thickness and no fixed geometric basis captured more than 72% of their energy; mitigation is the stage-0d oracle before any training and, if needed, learned enrichment spans (gauge-free subspace-alignment loss) — but a space that must approach the fine interior converges to the teacher's cost.

Non-identifiability of the oracle fields: many interior configurations give near-identical boundary responses, so per-seat D*_c may not be a smooth local function of geometry; the nearest-to-nominal regulariser is a hypothesis, tested at stage 1 (within-seat held-out cells).

Cost claim is unmeasured: the 2-5 s per cell figure assumes GPU moment quadrature, batched patch eigen-solves and an FP64 reduced condensation that do not exist yet; today's pipeline is 30 s and consumer GPUs run FP64 at ~1/64 rate; the explicit 12.8k-RHS Schur export alone is ~1e12 flops.

Teacher non-smoothness: if the deciding modes are stabilisation-defined (γ-sweep) and labels are not regenerated, the unfloored ±3% gate is unreachable by any continuous surrogate near switching events; regeneration changes the teacher and must re-pass the Tet10 validation.

Sensitivities: the module sandwich bounds compliance and energy-norm displacement but not design derivatives; sensitivities have never been measured and are expected to be ~10× more sensitive than compliance; a surrogate can be within ε and have a wrong derivative, and enrichment-mode eigenvector derivatives are non-smooth at crossings (basis freezing per design step is a workaround with its own consistency cost).

Data regime: 33 (or 1024) global seats sparsely sample a ~12-parameter geometry space; the path relies on local descriptor coverage (tens of thousands of cells per seat), which must be registered against the TO design range and may need new teacher seats; CUT geometries have no labels at all today.

Clamping tension: a tight Loewner clamp gives strong structural guarantees but may forbid the anisotropic softening needed to fix the residual floor; loosening δ_s to 0.5 keeps the no-mechanism guarantee but moves the ±3% certificate from structure to validation.

FP64 discipline: any fp32 accumulation in assembly, projection, condensation or whitening injects additive error amplified by cond(A) = 7.2e4 (cond·u32 = 4e-3, up to d·u32·cond in the worst alignment); the pipeline must keep every additive step in FP64.

Heterogeneous assembly untested: exact composition was verified only for two copies of one seat; a TO lattice has different active node sets and GP faces on shared faces, which must reproduce a direct solve before any lattice claim.

Learning may add little over the no-learning reduced model: if the stage-0d space already passes ±10% with true material, the network's value is cost (smaller space, learned collar) rather than accuracy, and the plan must be re-scoped honestly rather than trained for its own sake.
literature_basis: Embedded symmetric positive semi-definite machine-learned elements for reduced-order modeling in finite-element simulations with application to threaded fasteners — learned static condensation is stable in coupled FE only in SPSD/factor form; unconstrained regressors destabilise the assembled solve.

Convex Neural Energy Elements: Monolithic Finite-Element Assembly of Geometry-Parameterized Neural Operators with Stability and Error Guarantees — geometry → PSD boundary quadratic form assembled monolithically; regularisation-nullspace principle for rigid modes.
Neural-operator element method (NOEM) — one reusable neural superelement in energy form assembled with ordinary FE.

Principal-Part Decomposition for Neural Operator Learning of Dirichlet-to-Neumann Maps — DtN maps are non-smoothing; compute the principal part exactly and learn only a smooth residual (here: exact collar + computed core, learned multiplicative correction).
Learning local Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps of nonlinear elliptic PDEs with rough coefficients — local cell DtN operators on reduced trace spaces assembled into a coarse problem.
Locally Subspace-Informed Neural Operators for Efficient Multiscale PDE Solving (GMsFEM-NO) — gauge-free subspace-alignment loss for learned local bases (the learned-enrichment fallback).

Learning Adaptive Coarse Spaces Using Transferable Neural Network Models for Linear and Nonlinear Overlapping Domain Decomposition Methods — soft interface eigenmodes are predictable from local data with sign-invariant losses.

Optimal local approximation spaces for component-based static condensation procedures / Static condensation optimal port/interface reduction and error estimation — Kolmogorov n-width of harmonic extensions, exponential decay, reuse across geometries (sizes the enrichment).
A static condensation reduced basis element method: approximation and a posteriori error estimation — energy-norm certification of assembled approximate local Schur complements.

Stress-constrained topology optimization of lattice-like structures using component-wise reduced order models — consistent adjoint sensitivities through reduced Schur complements; derivative-like quantities ~10× more sensitive than displacements.
Factored Sparse Approximate Inverse Preconditioning via Spectral Optimization — detached Rayleigh (frozen Ritz vector) gradients for extreme-eigenvalue losses.
Learning Interface Conditions in Domain Decomposition Solvers — max-over-probes power-iteration loss converging to the spectral radius; Frobenius-optimal ≠ worst-case-optimal.
Spectral Analysis of the Weighted Frobenius Objective — why averaged/weighted Frobenius losses concentrate error in soft modes; whitening equalises modes.

Learning from Linear Algebra: A Graph Neural Network Approach to Preconditioner Design for Conjugate Gradient Solvers (PreCorrector) — learn a zero-initialised correction on top of a classical object; A^{-1}-weighted loss is the whitened Frobenius norm.
Neural Network Layers for Prediction of Positive Definite Elastic Stiffness Tensors — Cholesky/log-diagonal SPD output layers for per-cell 6×6 tensors improve accuracy as well as admissibility.
Learning Constitutive Relations using Symmetric Positive Definite Neural Networks — SPD-NN and indirect (solve-in-the-loop) training through the assembled FE solve.
CubeNet: Equivariance to 3D Rotation and Translation — cube-group group convolutions on voxel grids (extended here to the full 48-element group).
Neural Level Set Topology Optimization Using Unfitted Finite Elements — ghost-penalty stabilisation is discontinuous in the level set; volumetric/continuous stabilisation is differentiable.
Linking ghost penalty and aggregated unfitted methods — locking-free extension-based GP interpolating continuously toward AgFEM (basis of the C¹-blended regenerated teacher).

On the design of locking free ghost penalty stabilization and the relation to CutFEM with discrete extension — free choice of stabilised functional and connectivity, enabling smooth volume-fraction weights.
The aggregated unfitted finite element method for elliptic problems — extension of ill-posed cut cells to well-posed roots; threshold discontinuity to be smoothed.
Robust and scalable domain decomposition solvers for unfitted finite element methods — unfitted interface Schur complements need stiffness-based weighting; BDDC with per-cell blocks (lattice solver).
Concurrent multiscale analysis without meshing: Microscale representation with CutFEM and micro/macro model blending — smooth blending between a resolved cut collar and a coarse interior.
A ROM-based BDDC solver for unfitted p-FEM level-set-based two-dimensional lattice structures — affine (moment-based) decomposition of unfitted lattice-cell stiffness assembled by BDDC.
Projection-based reduced order models for a cut finite element method in parametrized domains — represent all geometries on the common background space with a canonical extension.
A trust region framework for managing the use of approximation models in optimization — first-order-consistent surrogate management with periodic truth evaluations.

Progressive construction of a parametric reduced-order model for PDE-constrained optimization / A non-conforming dual approach for adaptive Trust-Region Reduced Basis approximation of PDE-constrained optimization — error-indicator-sized trust regions for surrogates in the optimisation loop.

Approximate reanalysis in topology optimization / Efficient stress-constrained topology optimization using inexact design sensitivities / One-shot procedures for efficient minimum compliance topology optimization — consistent sensitivities of the computed surrogate, sensitivity-based stopping, primary-load-path robustness to inexact analysis.
Multiscale topology optimization using neural network surrogate models — Sobolev training on derivatives that TO consumes.
Discrete energy as an exact label-free training objective for finite-element surrogates — energy gap = ½ squared energy-norm error; the exact per-load error functional for the task-level suite.
Message-Passing GNNs Fail to Approximate Sparse Triangular Factorizations — factor entries are non-local; do not regress them with local networks (why the learned quantity must be local).

Elliptic PDE learning is provably data-efficient / Learning elliptic partial differential equations with randomized linear algebra — accuracy is guaranteed only in directions the probes excite (Γ_ε); probe with the teacher's soft eigenvectors.
Learning Composable Energy Surrogates for PDE Order Reduction — data aggregation on the interface displacement distribution induced by assembly.
Element learning: a systematic approach of accelerating finite element-type methods via machine learning — per-element in2out (trace) and in2sol (interior recovery) heads assembled on any domain.
Data Complexity Estimates for Operator Learning — no polynomial sample guarantee for non-Lipschitz global maps; compositional locality is the only route with 33-1024 seats.

# ReCell: a physics-structured path from TPMS geometry to the interface Schur complement

## 1. Thesis

The measured facts fix the shape of any viable design. The verdict is a worst-direction statistic, eps_op = max|mu−1|, on a pencil with cond(A) = 7.2e4; three of 12,792 modes decided a verdict and every averaged loss misleads by ~100x [METRIC]. Additive error on A is amplified by cond(A) (±3% needs 4.2e-7 relative worst case), factor error is unamplified but still needs ~1e-4 per entry [ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS], and soft stiffness is a near/far cancellation of ratio 1e3-1e4 that no spatial band survives (eps_op 58 at radius 0.25, ~300 damaged modes at every radius) [STRUCTURE OF S]. Any representation that emits S or its factor must produce two large, nearly cancelling quantities to 1e-4..1e-5 coherence; no neural result in the project is within two orders of magnitude of that (V1: 27% e_A, mu_max 670 [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]).

There is one rung of the amplification ladder where the requirement is ordinary. If a reduced model is assembled from local SPD contributions and each is within a Loewner factor (1±δ) of its target, the assembled stiffness and its exact Schur complement are within (1±δ) too: sums, congruences and Schur complements preserve Loewner order. A 3% gate becomes a 3% requirement on local tensors. The one experiment in this family (one fine collar layer, a Q1 core of 1096 cells, one 6×6 SPD tensor per cell, 23,016 numbers) reached eps_op 0.15, and its failure to pass ±10% is a proven kinematic floor (mu_max ≥ 1.111 for any positive-definite material) [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED e], a property of the reduced space, not of learning. ReCell is that family with the floor removed by construction, the learned part structurally bounded, and the inference cost engineered and measured rather than assumed. This is the literature's recommendation for DtN-type maps as well: compute the non-smoothing principal part exactly and learn only a smooth residual ("Principal-Part Decomposition for Neural Operator Learning of Dirichlet-to-Neumann Maps"), and keep the learned superelement SPSD by construction ("Embedded symmetric positive semi-definite machine-learned elements…", "Convex Neural Energy Elements…").

## 2. Representation

Ŝ(g) is the exact Schur complement, onto the exactly computed trace set, of a reduced SPD system K_red = Vᵀ K_fine V with blockwise learned corrections Θ(θ).

**K_fine(g).** The full CutFEM Q2 + ghost-penalty stiffness (231,192 dofs at seat 0328), assembled exactly from the 65³ analytic fields. Every cut-cell element matrix is linear in 125 monomial moments of the material region; GP face matrices are constants selected by the exact face set. Assembly is cheap (body assembly 0.44 s measured); the teacher's 31.85 s on 64 cores is the factorisation of the 218k-dof interior with 79% GP fill, not the assembly [GOAL]. The exact active set, GP graph and trace set come with it, so the discontinuous combinatorics of the label map (a +0.01% thickness change activating a 5.6e-15-volume cell and three GP faces, moving one 1.1e-6-stiffness direction by 59.8% [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]) are computed, not interpolated.

**V(g), a geometry-computed Galerkin subspace of the fine space.** V = [I_trace ⊕ I_collar ⊕ Φ_core ⊕ Φ_enr]: (i) the fine collar, all fine dofs within k layers of the trace, kept exactly (k = 1 ≈ 40k dofs; k = 2 is a lever); (ii) a coarse core on the 16³ grid with Q2 or Q1+EAS kinematics embedded in the fine Q2 space by interpolation, so the core is a subspace; (iii) per coarse cell, m ∈ [4, 16] enrichment modes computed at inference from K_fine restricted to an oversampled patch (cell plus one ring, 3-8k fine dofs): the lowest generalised eigenmodes of the local energy (GenEO/GMsFEM type, material-adaptive, exactly the modes that thin, high-contrast material needs) and/or shell-kinematic modes u = u_mid + θ×(x−x_mid) on the local mid-surface φ = 0, multiplied by a partition of unity. Only span(V) enters, so this representation has no gauge, unlike SVD factors of an H-matrix [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]. With Θ = I the model is Galerkin: Ŝ_nom ≥ S exactly (the collar model measured mu_min = 1.000), and its excess η = mu_max − 1 is the Kolmogorov n-width of A-harmonic extensions in V ("Optimal local approximation spaces for component-based static condensation procedures"), computable on labelled seats with the fine factor by the existing Loewner-bound tool. Because energy excess is the square of the energy-norm approximation error, η ≤ 0.03 requires only a 17% energy-norm approximation of every harmonic extension; the Q1 core failed this because it cannot bend a sheet two elements thick, which is the physical content of the 1.111 floor.

**Θ(θ), the learned part.** Per coarse cell c and per enrichment block, an SPD multiplicative correction in log-Cholesky form around the projected nominal tensor, D_c = L_c^nom exp(Σ_c) (L_c^nom)ᵀ, with eig(exp Σ_c) clamped to [1−δ_s, 1+δ_h]. Twenty-one numbers per cell; 23k-50k numbers per cell in total rather than 1.2e7 (H-matrix) or 8.2e7 (dense factor). Structural consequences: symmetric and PSD; exact six-dimensional rigid null space (strain operators annihilate rigid motions for any tensor, so the diagonal-only attractor that held ten Frobenius rounds at 38.8% cannot exist [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]); exact O_h equivariance with an equivariant encoder; Loewner-monotone in θ; a teacher-free sandwich (1−δ_s)S ≤ Ŝ ≤ (1+δ_h)(1+η)S for every geometry (no spurious mechanisms, assembled SPD-ness and conditioning bounded; the failure Parish et al. found fatal for coupled solves is excluded by construction); and the ×1 amplification: if the network is within Loewner δ_net of the per-seat oracle tensors D*_c, then eps_op(Ŝ) ≤ δ_net + eps_fit + δ_net·eps_fit. The clamp is a genuine design tension: δ_s ≤ 0.03 gives a fully structural two-sided certificate but may forbid the anisotropic softening needed to fix a residual floor; δ_s up to 0.5 keeps the no-mechanism guarantee and moves the ±3% certificate to validation. Stage 0 decides.

The deployed operator is literally Ŝ = BᵀÂB on the exact trace set. The reduced cell model itself (~60k dofs) is an equally valid, assemblable carrier because exact condensation composes to 1e-12 [ASSEMBLY].

## 3. Teacher and data

**Teacher.** Keep the frozen GP teacher as reference, but run first the γ-sweep on 0328 (γ = 1e-3 and 1e-5, two teacher runs) and read the whitened spectrum between variants. If more than ~20 modes move by >10%, the deciding soft directions are stabilisation-defined and the labels are regenerated with a continuous stabilisation: keep the GP form but make each face or aggregation weight a C¹ function w(v) of the neighbouring cut cell's volume fraction, vanishing at the threshold, in the extension-based, locking-free form of "Linking ghost penalty and aggregated unfitted methods" and "On the design of locking free ghost penalty stabilization…" — the hard classifier that flipped mu_max to 1.25 under a 1e-12 threshold change [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY] is removed by construction, every direction stays FP64-measurable [STRUCTURE OF S], and the physical bending floor (cond ≈ (L/2h_node)·12(L/t)² ≈ 7e4 for a sheet two elements thick) is untouched. Acceptance of a regenerated teacher: Tet10 compliance validation unchanged (0.05-0.10%) and whitened central differences at h = 1e-4 vs 1e-3 agreeing to O(h²). Cost ≈ 9 h on 64 cores for 1024 cells.

**Labels.** (i) Factor all 1024 condensed packets on GPU (dense Cholesky at d ≈ 13k is ~7e11 flops, seconds; the largest q ≈ 48k about a minute), turning 33 whitened labels into 1024 while preserving the registered splits. (ii) Per-seat oracle fields D*_c: fit the corrections through the exact condensation against R* with a nearest-to-nominal Thompson-metric regulariser, so the field is unique and continuous in geometry (the collar's tensors were never asked whether they were a function of geometry; this is the day-one question). (iii) Local labels without the teacher: the exact oversampled local condensation per coarse cell (milliseconds) as a homogenised nominal tensor, ~1e3 per cell × 1024 cells × 48 symmetries ≈ 5e7 local samples. (iv) Per-node compliance scales from packets (R² 0.98 locally [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]) as auxiliary targets. **CUT cells** have no factored labels [GOAL]; ~100 CUT seats are generated (~1 h) before any CUT claim. **Coverage** is registered in local-descriptor space (t = 2τ/|∇φ|, curvature, orientation, volume fraction, GP-face count) against the TO design range; cross-seat operator distances of eps_op 536-3847 [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY] are irrelevant to a local-field learner, but descriptor coverage is not. The 48 cube operations are used as exact equivariance, not augmentation.

## 4. Architecture

Input: the 65³×11 analytic fields plus exact discrete channels computed from the level set (active mask, volume fraction, GP-face count, node support measure, cut-plane distance, coordinates) — full 3D, never six face images. Encoder: an O_h-equivariant 3D group-convolutional U-Net (CubeNet-style, extended to reflections), ≤ 5M parameters, whose coarsest level gives a global receptive field while every output is local; bf16/fp32 trunk. Heads, all weight-shared and equivariant: H1 emits Σ_c per coarse cell (rank-2 tensor in Voigt form, clamped); H2 the enrichment-block correction; H3 an auxiliary compliance-scale head used for whitening and regularisation; H4, later, a learned collar-patch head trained on local condensation labels to replace cut-cell collar assembly if it dominates cost. The deterministic exact decoder in FP64: GPU moment quadrature → K_fine; batched patch eigen-solves → Φ_enr; sparse projection VᵀK_fine V; blockwise correction; nested-dissection Cholesky of the reduced interior; explicit Schur export or implicit action; Ŝ = BᵀÂB. Everything the network emits is O(1) in a multiplicative gauge, so heads need ~1e-2 accuracy and fp32 suffices there; every additive step is FP64 because cond(A)·u32 = 4e-3 already sits at the gate. Factor entries are non-local ("Message-Passing GNNs Fail to Approximate Sparse Triangular Factorizations"); ReCell never asks a network for them.

## 5. Loss and training

Stage A pretrains the heads on local labels with the Thompson distance on the SPD cone, d_T(D, D*) = max|log eig(D*^{-1/2} D D*^{-1/2})|, the exact quantity that enters the ×1 amplification. Stage B trains end-to-end through the exact condensation on the whitened pencil M = R*^{-T}ÂR*^{-1}, applied implicitly (one reduced solve plus two dense triangular solves per matvec). Warm-started block Lanczos/LOBPCG with 32 vectors per end (stiff end on M, soft end on (A, Â)), 2-5 iterations per step, restarts every ~100 steps, and the teacher's softest eigenvectors as fixed probes so that the deciding directions are always excited ("Learning elliptic partial differential equations with randomized linear algebra": accuracy is guaranteed only where the probes look). Gradients by Hellmann-Feynman with frozen Ritz vectors ("Factored Sparse Approximate Inverse Preconditioning via Spectral Optimization"): d mu_k/dθ = w_kᵀ(dÂ/dθ)w_k, and since wᵀŜw is a minimum energy, the gradient with respect to each cell's tensor is the strain energy of the worst modes' reduced harmonic extension in that cell — adjoint sensitivities, k sparse solves per step, no eigen-backprop. The loss is two-sided from step one (a one-sided term moved mu_max 15→5 while mu_min 0.13→0.05 [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]): softmax-hinge over |log mu_k| beyond ε with a curriculum ε: 0.3→0.1→0.03, plus the whitened divergence D/d as a bulk/conditioning term that is never a gate [METRIC], plus a Schatten-2k Hutchinson term tr((M−I)^{2k})^{1/2k} as a smooth, d-almost-independent upper bound on eps_op. Second-order (Gauss-Newton/K-FAC) steps on head parameters: the whitened objective in the multiplicative gauge is well conditioned, which is why Newton with column scaling converged where raw Adam produced NaN [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]. Stage C fine-tunes on assemblies with adjoint compliance sensitivities matched to the teacher's stable task-level derivative (0.023% [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]), Sobolev-style, following "Multiscale topology optimization using neural network surrogate models". Acceptance is read only from frozen checkpoints by the full FP64 spectrum.

## 6. Acceptance and deployment, with the solve cost stated honestly

**Contract (decision 1).** The module-level Loewner sandwich, eps_op ≤ 0.10 work and 0.03 target, on held-out labelled seats: it composes exactly to any lattice, load and design and it is sharp, whereas the 0.31% compliance error at eps_op 0.152 was alignment luck [ASSEMBLY]. Added: the teacher-free bound Ŝ ≥ (1−δ_s)S for every geometry with the empirical η distribution, and a registered task-level suite that must also pass — compliance ≤ 0.3% (below the Tet10 refinement change), energy-norm displacement ≤ ε, adjoint design-sensitivity error ≤ 5% without sign errors on registered load families, since sensitivities are first order in the operator error, untested, and expected to behave like stress (~10× worse than compliance, per "Stress-constrained topology optimization of lattice-like structures using component-wise reduced order models"). A floored metric is adopted only if the γ-sweep shows stabilisation-defined deciding modes, and then registered explicitly.

**Deployment (decisions 2, 3).** Mode A, with a reduced interior solve at inference accepted as the price of near/far coherence. Per new cell, estimated: GPU moment quadrature and fine assembly ≈ 0.5 s; batched patch eigen-solves ≈ 0.5-1 s; network ≈ 0.1 s; FP64 reduced factorisation ≈ 0.5 s; explicit 12.8k-RHS Schur export ≈ 1e12 flops, 1-3 s on a data-centre FP64 GPU (≈10 s on a consumer part), or milliseconds per implicit action. That is ≈ 2-5 s per cell against 31.85 s × 64 cores — roughly 10× wall-clock and ~100× hardware — and it is an estimate to be measured in stage 0e; today's 30 s collar pipeline is CPU tooling (17.7 s local assembly, 7.7 s pre-elimination). For lattices of ~10³ cells, dense per-cell S (1.3 GB) was never an option; the reduced cells (~6e7 dofs) are assembled and solved with a BDDC-type preconditioned CG whose per-cell block is the implicit Ŝ ("Robust and scalable domain decomposition solvers for unfitted finite element methods"), or Ŝ is stored H-compressed at ~15% of dense. In TO, the cheaply assembled K_fine yields a per-cell a-posteriori residual of the reduced harmonic extension, used as a trust-region indicator with teacher checkpoints (32 s per cell) at trust-region centres and at the final design ("A trust region framework for managing the use of approximation models in optimization", "A non-conforming dual approach for adaptive Trust-Region Reduced Basis approximation…"); sensitivities are the consistent adjoint of the surrogate with the enrichment basis frozen per design step ("Approximate reanalysis in topology optimization"). Mode B stays a fallback: the reduced model is a natural preconditioner for the fine interior, but each fine action is a 218k-dof PCG, uneconomic for an explicit Ŝ.

## 7. Staged plan

**Stage 0 (week 1, no training).** (a) γ-sweep on 0328: count modes moving >10%; >20 triggers regeneration or a floored contract. (b) Classify the deciding modes of the 0.03/0.047/0.15 verdicts (thickness-exponent test: uniform τ scaling gives mu ≈ 1+δ for membrane, (1+δ)³ for bending; energy partition with the level-set normal). (c) Interior-vs-boundary switch test: does an interior sliver activation move eps_op smoothly while a collar one jumps? (d) Loewner floor η on four seats for collar depth {1,2} × core {Q1, Q2, Q2+EAS} × m ∈ {0,4,8,16}; outcome: a space with η ≤ 0.05 at ≤ 80k dofs, and the cheapest no-learning space passing ±10%. (e) GPU timings of quadrature, patch solves and reduced condensation; outcome ≤ 5 s per cell. (f) Factor the 1024 packets. Cost: one GPU week plus a few teacher hours.

**Stage 1 (weeks 2-3, oracle fits).** D*_c on 8-16 seats; eps_fit ≤ 0.05 falsifies or confirms the floor removal. Tensor-level noise test (1e-2, 3e-2, 1e-1 in log-Cholesky) must show eps_op ≈ perturbation size. Within-seat identifiability (ridge/kNN from local descriptors, 20% of cells held out, substitute, recondense) must land within 2× eps_fit; if not, one learned-enrichment attempt with a gauge-free subspace-alignment loss ("Locally Subspace-Informed Neural Operators…").

**Stage 2 (weeks 3-5).** One-seat memorisation of 0328 with the full pipeline: the first neural eps_op the project will have; outcome train eps_op ≤ 0.10 and a measured residual noise model. **Stage 3 (weeks 5-8).** Leave-one-seat-out on 33, then 1024 labels with stage-A pretraining: held-out median ≤ 0.10, max ≤ 0.15. **Stage 4 (weeks 8-10).** Heterogeneous 2-cell/2×2×2/4×4×4 assemblies, sensitivities, indicator calibration. **Stage 5 (weeks 10-14).** CUT seats, regeneration if triggered, mini-TO with trust region: objective within 1% of teacher-driven TO, thin-feature differences registered. **Stage 6 (weeks 14-20).** ε = 0.03 curriculum, learned collar patches, lattice solver, like-for-like benchmark including the assembled solve on both sides.

## 8. Kill criteria

No computed space ≤ 100k dofs with η ≤ 0.05 (stage 0d); reduced pipeline > 10 s per cell on a data-centre GPU (0e); stabilisation-defined deciding modes with neither regeneration nor a floored contract accepted (0a); 3% tensor noise costing > 0.06 eps_op, or held-out cells scattering to > 2× eps_fit after regularisation and one learned-enrichment attempt (stage 1); no one-seat memorisation to 0.10 in five GPU-days while the oracle sits at 0.05 (stage 2); held-out median > 0.30 with training at the floor on 1024 labels (stage 3); sensitivities > 20% or sign errors at eps_op 0.10 (stage 4); mini-TO optimum > 3% worse than the teacher's on two of three benchmarks (stage 5). Each stops the corresponding claim; the no-learning reduced model from 0d survives as a deliverable whenever it passes ±10% on its own.

## 9. What is discarded

The TᵀDT lifting backend and its descent line, the banded-L + low-rank-M representation with the V0/V1 six-face CNN, the closed-form D oracle and fixed-L reachability tools, the free dense factor as a target (kept as a loss-ceiling diagnostic), the H-matrix as a learning target (kept as storage format and evaluation reference), D/d as a headline, probe supervision, no-GP assets, the hard-classifier GP prototype, and augmentation-only symmetry. Kept: the FP64 full-spectrum evaluator, assembly harnesses (extended to heterogeneous cells and adjoints), storage_floor, the teacher rebuild chain, the Loewner-bound tool, the B2 collar pipeline as the seed, the per-entry noise tools repurposed to tensors, the compliance-scale regressor, and the 1024 packets with 33 factors (991 to be factored).

## 10. Key risks

The enriched space may still not capture modes that vary along thin curves and oscillate across thickness (no fixed basis exceeded 72% of their energy); the oracle fields may be non-identifiable; the cost claim rests on GPU code that does not exist; the teacher's non-smoothness may force a regeneration that must re-pass Tet10; sensitivities are unbounded by the module sandwich and enrichment eigenvectors are non-smooth at crossings; CUT geometries have no labels; the Loewner clamp trades certificate strength against fixable anisotropy; any fp32 additive step is amplified by 7.2e4; heterogeneous assembly is unverified; and learning may add little if the computed space already passes, in which case the plan is re-scoped to cost rather than trained for its own sake.

## 11. Literature basis

SPD/energy-form learned superelements (Parish et al.; "Convex Neural Energy Elements"; NOEM; "Neural Network Layers for Prediction of Positive Definite Elastic Stiffness Tensors"; "Learning Constitutive Relations using Symmetric Positive Definite Neural Networks"); principal-part/residual splitting and local DtN learning (Ling-Ying-Zhou; Boutilier-Brenner-Miguez; GMsFEM-NO; Klawonn-Lanser-Weber-Hamacher); port/enrichment theory and certified condensation (Smetana-Patera; Huynh-Knezevic-Patera; McBane-Choi-Willcox); worst-direction losses (Brarda et al.; Taghibakhshi et al.; Trifonov et al. weighted-Frobenius analysis; PreCorrector); cube-group equivariance (CubeNet); unfitted-method continuity and stabilisation design (Mallon et al.; Badia-Neiva-Verdugo; Burman-Hansbo-Larson; AgFEM; Badia-Verdugo BDDC; Mikaeili-Claus-Kerfriden; Bonilla Moreno-Guarino-Antolin; Karatzas-Ballarin-Rozza); surrogate management in TO (Alexandrov et al.; Zahr-Farhat; Keil et al.; Amir 2009/2021/2024; White et al.; Cao-Song energy objective); and the negative results that shape the division of labour (Trifonov-Muravleva-Oseledets on factors; Kovachki-Lanthaler-Mhaskar on data complexity; Boullé-Townsend on probe coverage).
